result.description:
About our Organisation 
VENTORA is the name behind iconic Australian brands including A&L Windows & Doors, Breezway louvres, Corinthian Doors, Stegbar Windows & Doors and Trend Windows & Doors.
As an established manufacturer with over 4,500 employees, our vision is to inspire our customers through leading brands, great service, innovative new products and solutions leveraging the full VENTORA portfolio, while significantly enhancing our ease of doing business built on operational excellence.

About the Opportunity
We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.
Responsibilities include:
•	Drive COPQ Reduction Across Sites: Lead initiatives to identify, address, and reduce COPQ at each manufacturing site, fast-tracking reduction actions.
•	Support Transformation Projects: Provide operational support for the successful execution of Transformation Projects, aiming to modernize manufacturing processes and systems.
•	Red List Site Support: Work directly with Red List sites to build operational foundations and enhance manufacturing readiness for growth, ensuring these sites meet operational standards.
•	Enhance Manufacturing Efficiency: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce downtime, improve throughput, and optimize resource utilization across sites.
•	Leadership Support: Assist site leaders in improving operational performance, driving COPQ reduction, and supporting data-driven decision-making to foster a culture of continuous improvement. 
•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across functions to drive transformation projects and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
•	People Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop operational leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
•	Results-Oriented: A focus on achieving measurable results and driving continuous improvement across all operational areas.
•	Time Management: Effective time management and organizational skills to prioritize tasks, manage workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.
•	Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and implement innovative solutions to improve manufacturing processes and drive operational excellence.
•	Adaptability: Ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
•	Driver’s License: Hold a current unrestricted driver’s license to perform the requirements of the role.
•	Educational Qualification: A diploma or degree in a relevant discipline (business, engineering, manufacturing) or equivalent experience is preferred.

About the Benefits
•	Permanent, full time role with established industry leader
•	Annual salary: $150,000 - $180,000 (depending on experience) + super.
•	Flexible work arrangements, with 2 days per week WFH
•	Generous discounts on our extensive range of products
•	Ability to schedule leave every year over the Christmas period.
•	Additional paid day’s leave on your birthday
•	Flare benefits program - salary packaging, discounts and premium perks
•	Employee Assistance Program access
•	Career progression opportunities as part of a 4,500-employee organisation
result.title: Operational Excellence & COPQ Transformation Specialist

result.description: Hayman Industries   Duties and Responsibilities    Review blueprints and drawings, and taking measurements to plan layout and procedures  Prepare for the job from selecting and preparing metal and determining the appropriate welding tools/ equipment/ machineries and method based on requirements  Mark-out reference points for columns or plates, following blueprints and using straightedges squares, transits and measuring instruments.  Align, cut, shape, fabricate and bend metals using the appropriate tools, equipment and machineries.  Join metals and structures using welding, bolting and riveting methods  Weld steel components with welding equipment as specified by layouts, engineering drawings, work orders or verbal instructions. Ensure to examine work for width of bead, penetration and precision.  Ensure the finishing product is clean and smooth by filing, chiselling and grinding. Also, polish, fill and bathe finished welds in acidic solutions. Physical Stamina and good hand-eye coordination  Understanding of hazardous material handling and knowledge of safety protocols and regulations  Strong communication and problem-solving capabilities  Attention to detain  Team collaboration   About Company    Since the 1950's, Hayman Industries has been at the forefront of steel products manufacturing and fabrication.  From its humble beginnings as a distributor of fence fittings and horseshoes to rural NSW, Hayman Industries has grown to be the leading manufacturer and supplier of engineered steel structures to a whole range of industries including utilities, power stations, roads and traffic authorities and companies involved in construction and infrastructure projects across Australia. Due to our continued expansion, we are seeking skilled Welders and Boilermakers to join our dynamic team. result.description:
Head Chef – Surly's Surry Hills

Position Title: Head Chef
Reports To: General Manager
Business: Surly's Hospitality Pty Ltd
Venue: Surly's American Tavern
Location: 182 Campbell Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary: AUD $85,000 per annum plus statutory superannuation

Position Summary

The Head Chef is responsible for the overall leadership and management of the kitchen operations at Surly's American Tavern. This is a full-time senior management position responsible for menu development, food quality, kitchen leadership, financial performance, compliance with food safety legislation, and the efficient operation of a high-volume commercial kitchen.

The role is integral to the ongoing success of the business and requires an experienced chef capable of leading a diverse kitchen team while maintaining consistently high culinary standards, operational efficiency, and profitability.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

- Manage and oversee the daily operations of the kitchen, ensuring efficient service and consistently high food quality.
- Develop, design and implement seasonal menus, daily specials, catering packages and function menus that align with the Surly's brand.
- Plan recipes, portion sizes and menu pricing to maximise profitability while maintaining quality and consistency.
Supervise all food preparation and cooking to ensure presentation, quality, portion control and customer satisfaction standards are consistently achieved.
- Recruit, train, mentor and supervise kitchen employees including Sous Chefs, Chef de Parties, Commis Chefs, Apprentices and Kitchen Hands.
- Prepare staff rosters and allocate duties to ensure efficient kitchen operations and appropriate labour utilisation.
- Monitor labour costs, food costs, gross profit margins and kitchen productivity to achieve business budgets and financial targets.
- Order food, beverages and kitchen supplies, manage supplier relationships and negotiate purchasing where appropriate.
- Monitor inventory levels and implement stock control systems to minimise wastage and maximise profitability.
- Ensure compliance with all Food Safety Standards, HACCP principles, NSW Food Authority requirements and Work Health and Safety legislation.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve kitchen procedures, systems and operational standards.
- Coordinate preventative maintenance of kitchen equipment and arrange repairs as required.
- Work collaboratively with senior management on marketing initiatives, promotional campaigns, special events and business development opportunities.
- Monitor customer feedback and implement continuous improvements to menu offerings and kitchen performance.
- Maintain accurate records relating to stock control, food cost analysis, labour costs, wastage and kitchen performance.
- Ensure high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food handling practices are maintained throughout the kitchen at all times.
- Foster a positive, professional and high-performing kitchen culture focused on teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement.
- Drive culinary innovation while maintaining the authentic American barbecue style and quality standards that define the Surly's brand.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate will possess:

- Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent recognised qualification).
- A minimum of five (5) years' relevant experience in a senior chef or Head Chef position.
- Demonstrated experience managing a high-volume commercial kitchen.
- Proven leadership and people management skills with the ability to recruit, train and develop kitchen staff.
- Strong understanding of menu planning, recipe development, food costing and inventory management.
- Excellent knowledge of budgeting, labour management and cost control.
- Comprehensive understanding of Australian food safety legislation, HACCP principles and workplace health and safety requirements.
- Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining high standards of food quality and customer service.
- Strong commitment to continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence.

Key Performance Outcomes

The Head Chef will be expected to:

- Deliver consistently high-quality food and presentation standards.
- Maintain food and labour costs within approved budgets.
- Lead, develop and retain a high-performing kitchen team.
- Ensure full compliance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.
- Support the commercial success of the business through effective menu engineering, operational efficiency and cost management.
- Contribute to the ongoing growth and reputation of Surly's American Tavern through culinary leadership and innovation.
result.title: Head Chef –  Surly's Surry Hills

## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to user queries regarding hardware and software problems, providing clear guidance and timely resolutions via phone, email, or in person
- Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues across a range of systems, applications, and devices, escalating complex matters to senior technical staff where appropriate
- Assess software and hardware requirements to develop practical solutions that meet user and business needs
- Install, configure, and update software applications and operating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across user environments
- Adapt and modify existing programmes and applications to align with evolving user requirements and organisational workflows
- Repair, replace, and maintain peripheral equipment including printers, terminals, modems, and other connected devices
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of computer networks, contributing to the configuration and ongoing support of network infrastructure
- Support the design, maintenance, and updating of websites and internal digital platforms as required
- Promote and educate end users on the efficient and effective use of applications, equipment, and IT systems to maximise productivity
- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
- Contribute to the development and documentation of IT support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles
- Provide support within a call centre environment where required, handling a high volume of inbound technical queries with professionalism and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate IV or Diploma in Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience in an ICT support, help desk, or technical services role
- Solid understanding of computer hardware, software applications, and operating systems (Windows and/or macOS)
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral equipment
- Familiarity with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting
- Proficiency in using IT ticketing and asset management systems to log, track, and resolve support requests
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues methodically and efficiently
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
- Customer-focused attitude with a professional, patient, and approachable manner
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure
## Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified, or ITIL Foundation
- Experience supporting users in a call centre or high-volume help desk environment
- Knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and remote desktop support tools
- Familiarity with website content management systems (CMS) and basic web maintenance tasks
- Experience working within ITIL or other IT service management frameworks
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certifications, and career development opportunities to advance your ICT career
- Enjoy flexibility in your working arrangements, with a consistent and structured shift schedule to support work-life balance
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly supports staff productivity and organisational success
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, recognising your skills and experience
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
